ticket.summary: Original 1990s outdoor hose bib on side of house sprays from the handle when opened (worn stem/packing); no leak when closed, gradually worsening over several months.
mitigation_advice: Leak is contained at a single fixture and stops when the handle is closed — advised to leave the spigot shut off until the tech arrives; no shutoff steps needed [PB-01]
ticket.customer_message: You're booked: Tue Sep 1 at 3:00 PM at 455 Meadowbrook Rd for an outdoor hose bib replacement — $169 flat rate, roughly 80 minutes. Just keep the spigot closed until then and skip the garden watering. The tech will call before arriving; if the price changes because of anything unexpected behind the wall, they'll confirm with you first. Thanks for texting us after hours!
